resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Hindi source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Hindi pass identified 25 remaining technical wording, terminology, notation, and unit-clarity defects across Ohm's law, Joule heating, Kirchhoff's laws, TCR, heat capacity, and SI prefixes; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Hindi human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law description used करंट instead of the clearer Hindi technical term धारा.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used mixed Hindi and loanword terminology for electric current.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the description with वोल्टेज, धारा, and प्रतिरोध.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law summary used करंट rather than consistent Hindi terminology.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used करंट in the short concept summary.
findings.resolution: Changed the summary to वोल्टेज, धारा और प्रतिरोध के बीच संबंध।

findings.summary: The watt conversion incorrectly named megawatts instead of milliwatts.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation stated 1 W = 1,000 मेगावाट, which is dimensionally incorrect.
findings.resolution: Corrected the conversion to 1 W = 1,000 mW.

findings.summary: The model-limits paragraph used an awkward transliteration for operating conditions.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used ऑपरेटिंग स्थिति in an otherwise Hindi technical paragraph.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the phrase as संचालन की स्थिति and standardized the current terminology.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating description mixed English heating terminology with Hindi wording.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used जूल हीटिंग and गर्मी in the concept description.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as जूल तापन and ऊष्मा for consistent technical Hindi.

findings.summary: The heating-power introduction was an incomplete literal phrase.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation said विद्युत ताप शक्ति है before listing the formulas.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a complete introduction: विद्युत तापन शक्ति का वर्णन इन संबंधों से किया जाता है।

findings.summary: The current definition used चालू, which means switched on rather than electric current.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation defined I with the misleading word चालू.
findings.resolution: Defined I as धारा and retained the protected ampere symbol A.

findings.summary: The worked-example setup used an unnatural verb construction for current flow.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation said a coil में 3 A होता है.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as एक 0.8 Ω कुंडल में 3 A धारा बहती है।

findings.summary: The safety check mixed loanwords for current, power, and thermal margin.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used करंट, पावर, and हेडरूम in the safety instruction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the instruction with धारा, शक्ति, and पर्याप्त सुरक्षा-मार्जिन.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description used mixed transliterations for circuit concepts.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation referred to सर्किट नोड्स and बंद लूप in the description.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the description with परिपथ, नोडों, and बंद पाशों.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff summary used the awkward loanword कनेक्टेड.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation began the summary with कनेक्टेड सर्किट में.
findings.resolution: Changed it to जुड़े हुए परिपथ में धारा और वोल्टेज का व्यवहार।

findings.summary: The current-law example used literal direction wording and localized ampere units inconsistently.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used ए and said a branch धारा को दूर ले जाती है.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the example with A, धारा बाहर ले जाती है, and a clear negative-result explanation.

findings.summary: The series-current formula localized the protected total-current variable.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used I_कुल rather than a stable Latin variable name.
findings.resolution: Changed the formula to I_total = I_1 = I_2 = ...

findings.summary: The parallel-current formula localized the total-current variable.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used I_कुल in the parallel-current formula.
findings.resolution: Changed the formula to I_total = I_1 + I_2 + ...

findings.summary: The parallel-resistance formula localized the protected total-resistance variable.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used R_कुल in the parallel-resistance formula.
findings.resolution: Changed the formula to 1 / R_total = 1 / R_1 + 1 / R_2 + ...

findings.summary: The series-resistor example mixed Devanagari variables and unit names into the formula.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used मैं, वी, and ए in a numerical formula.
findings.resolution: Changed it to I = 8.0 V / 0.40 Ω = 20 A.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor example localized the total-resistance variable.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used R_कुल in the numerical example.
findings.resolution: Changed it to R_total = 0.20 Ω.

findings.summary: The parallel-current example mixed Latin and Devanagari variable and unit forms.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation ended the formula with 20 ए.
findings.resolution: Standardized it as I_total = 4.0 V / 0.20 Ω = 20 A.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving instruction transliterated the standard KCL and KVL acronyms.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used केसीएल and केवीएल instead of the standard Latin acronyms.
findings.resolution: Changed the instruction to use KCL and KVL.

findings.summary: The TCR unit used a localized transliteration for ppm.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used पीपीएम/°C in a technical unit definition.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit notation to the standard ppm/°C.

findings.summary: The TCR power formula localized the protected voltage and current variables.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used मैं = वी/आर in the formula.
findings.resolution: Changed it to I = V / R.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating formula localized all protected variables.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used क्यू = पी × टी rather than the shared notation.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Q = P × t.

findings.summary: The ideal-heating-time example localized the time, energy, and power variables and units.
evidence: The previous Hindi presentation used टी, जे, and डब्ल्यू in the numerical formula.
findings.resolution: Changed it to t = 41,800 J / 100 W = 418 s.

findings.summary: The SI prefix table translated micro as कुटीर, which is not the name of the prefix.
evidence: The previous Hindi table labeled the 10^-6 prefix कुटीर.
findings.resolution: Changed the prefix name to माइक्रो.

findings.summary: The SI prefix table gave the nano factor as 10^-9 but wrote the decimal with one zero too few.
evidence: The previous Hindi table stated 0.0000001 = 10^-9, an inconsistent factor.
findings.resolution: Corrected the decimal to 0.000000001 = 10^-9.
